dr_brief.identification: limping to the car after a 12; the shoes felt fine at 7 AM
dr_brief.point_of_contact: It's my shoes / the hard floors / I'm just getting older (confirm shoes, reframe age)
dr_brief.problem_mechanism: Her 'comfortable' sneakers were built for short forward runs: tapered toe box pinches, raised heel tips weight onto the balls of the feet, soft foam compresses by hour 4-6, and feet swell through the day so a 7 AM fit clamps by 2 PM.
dr_brief.function_mechanism: Insoles sit inside the same narrow shoe and clogs don't give; she needs support that doesn't flatten plus room that gives as feet swell, in one shoe.
dr_brief.solution_mechanism: Ortho Stretch puts all three in one shoe: built-in arch support + cushioned rocker sole, stretch-knit upper + wide toe box that gives as feet swell, no-tie laces.
dr_brief.conditions: Sizing up slips at the heel; insoles eat toe room; most comfort shoes pick support OR give.
dr_brief.usp: The only shoe she's found with built-in support AND stretch-knit room in one, at $59.95

features.stretch-knit upper + wide toe box: odds/dream (room as feet swell, no pinch)

dr_brief.anchoring: $59.95 vs a closet of $160-$220 pairs that quit by lunchtime; at 60% off it's less than a dollar a shift.
dr_brief.risk_reversal: 30 days is enough to wear them through 10+ shifts or a whole trip and decide on her own feet; the bigger risk is another season in shoes that already failed. Never say 'easy returns'.
dr_brief.gain_now: 60% OFF SITEWIDE this Black Friday + free shipping & returns; code LEAKED10 for an extra 10%
dr_brief.lose_later: The Black Friday price ends when the sale ends (no stock/scarcity stories).
